dct_description_sm: This dataset contains the data that have been used for "Temporally and spatially variable coupling of carbon and mercury in boreal lake sediments", a scientific article currently under review, by Jessyca Guénette et al. This study aims to better understand the spatial and temporal patterns in the storage of carbon and mercury in boreal lakes sediment records among different regions of boreal Quebec, Canada.
dct_title_s: Data for the article "Temporally and spatially variable coupling of carbon and mercury in boreal lake sediments" [Quebec, Canada]
